description: This file defines the DaysAdapter class for an Android weather app, which populates a RecyclerView with daily weather data, fetching data via network requests and updating UI components accordingly.

classes.name: DaysAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying daily weather information in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: DaysAdapter.DayViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to UI components for each day item.

methods.name: DaysAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DayViewHolder instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: getDailyWeatherInfo
methods.description: Fetches daily weather data from the API and updates UI components.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI components with fetched weather data.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator and shows the weather info layout.
